project.name: Chief-Productivity-Officer
project.description: Discord Bot for productivity tracking, pomodoro timers, check-in standups, and study group management.

nodes.name: CPO Bot Core
nodes.description: Discord bot entry point. Manages gateway connection, extension/cog loading, app command synchronization, and error dispatching.

nodes.name: Database Handler
nodes.description: Thread-safe asynchronous SQLite persistence manager utilizing asyncio.Lock() for ACID concurrency.

nodes.name: Utils & Domain Services
nodes.description: Shared regex duration parsers, mention resolution, parameter validators, and productivity scoring engine.

commands.name: checkin
commands.description: Start an interactive checkin / standup session with periodic attendance pings.

commands.name: create_group
commands.description: Create a new study group and provision channels/roles.

commands.name: join_group
commands.description: Join an existing active study group.

commands.name: leave_group
commands.description: Leave a joined study group.

commands.name: end_group
commands.description: End study group session and cleanup resources.

commands.name: list_groups
commands.description: List all active study groups in guild.

commands.name: invite_to_group
commands.description: Invite another user to the study group.

commands.name: start_pomodoro
commands.description: Start a timed Pomodoro session (focus/break cycles).

commands.name: end_pomodoro
commands.description: End active Pomodoro session.

commands.name: pause_pomodoro
commands.description: Pause active Pomodoro timer.

commands.name: resume_pomodoro
commands.description: Resume paused Pomodoro timer.

commands.name: pomodoro_status
commands.description: Check remaining time and cycle statistics.

commands.name: add_bot_developer
commands.description: Add superuser bot developer.

commands.name: add_guild_manager
commands.description: Add server-level guild manager.

commands.name: remove_guild_manager
commands.description: Remove server-level guild manager.

commands.name: list_managers
commands.description: List all managers for the server.

commands.name: set_permission_level
commands.description: Explicitly set permission level for a user.

commands.name: task_add
commands.description: Add a new task to personal to-do list.

commands.name: task_complete
commands.description: Mark a task as complete by ID.

commands.name: task_list
commands.description: List active and completed tasks.

commands.name: productivity
commands.description: Display user productivity metrics embed.

commands.name: create_vc
commands.description: Create a dedicated voice channel for study group.

commands.name: delete_vc
commands.description: Delete voice channel associated with study group.

commands.name: delete_role
commands.description: Delete custom role associated with study group.
